Blocking: complete-block additive model, elimination of block effects, variance sigma^2 sum c_t^2/B, residual df (L-1)(B-1) and inability to separate interaction from pure error (200-257), proof annex 155-187; replicated full factorial pure-error df 2^k(n-1) (353-358) with worked pure-error estimate 5/8 (385-388). Failure condition not met.
